PROJECT 01 • MAIN FEATURED PROJECT

Lab Management System

Being deployed in the college lab

What the System Does

A web app built to manage our college laboratory. It helps lab assistants and teachers keep track of which student is sitting at which computer, who borrowed which hardware component (like Arduino boards, sensors, or multimeters), and log broken equipment so it gets repaired.

Features I Built

  • Student Attendance & Desks: Records student attendance and assigns them to specific computer desks in the lab.
  • Hardware Inventory: Tracks who checked out components (like microcontrollers, test probes, and meters) and when they return them.
  • User Roles: Separate permissions for students, lab assistants, and teachers.
  • Report Broken Equipment: Lets students and staff flag broken computers or equipment so they can be fixed.

Technologies Used

Python SQL Database REST APIs User Authentication HTML / SCSS / JS College Lab Network
How the Project Grew
EARLIER VERSION

Started as a simple desktop script and basic spreadsheet-style table to keep an inventory list on a single computer.

PRESENT VERSION

Upgraded into a full web app with user logins, role permissions, a shared database, and network setup for our college lab.

How the System Works Live Testing
Currently being tested and deployed in our college laboratory
PROJECT 02 // AUTOMATION

Megatron

Being prepared for college deployment

An automation tool built to run background tasks and monitor computer systems in our college labs. It runs scheduled maintenance scripts and checks if background programs are running properly, logging errors automatically to make diagnosing issues straightforward.

Python Automation Async Tasks System Monitoring Error Logging
Testing • College Deployment
PROJECT 03 // AI / ML PROJECT

Timetable Scheduler Using DFS

College deployment being planned

My AI/ML subject project that uses Depth-First Search (DFS) with backtracking to generate clash-free college class timetables. It assigns classes step by step, and if a clash occurs with teacher schedules or room sizes, it backtracks and tries another slot until a valid timetable is found.

Python Depth-First Search (DFS) Backtracking Constraint Solving AI/ML Subject
Academic Subject • Planning Deployment

About Me

A Bit About Me

An engineering student who enjoys building software, working with algorithms, and connecting microcontrollers to the real world.

I am Krishna Taneja, an engineering student. I like writing code, learning how systems work under the hood, and building projects that people can actually use. Whether that is helping our college lab manage equipment and attendance, writing search algorithms for timetable scheduling, or building circuits with microcontrollers, I focus on building things that work reliably.

I work across both software and hardware. On the software side, I build web applications and work with Python, algorithms, and databases. On the hardware side, I write embedded C/C++ code for microcontrollers, wire circuits on breadboards, and connect sensors using serial communication protocols.

Right now, I am focusing on deploying my Lab Management System in our college laboratory, testing my Megatron automation project, and practicing algorithmic problem-solving.

Web & Software Development

Building responsive web pages, writing backend logic in Python, and designing SQL databases.

AI & Search Algorithms

Using Depth-First Search (DFS) and backtracking to solve timetable scheduling and constraint problems.

Hardware & Electronics

Writing microcontroller code in C/C++, wiring sensors, and communicating over UART, I2C, and SPI.
